facts.label: real GDP quarterly growth
facts.quotation: In the third quarter, real GDP increased 3.1 percent.

claims.text: The supplied source is BEA's advance estimate of Q4 2024 real GDP and reports quarterly growth rates, not annual averages; the annual real GDP growth rates for 2023 and 2024 are not stated in the provided text.

claims.text: One could infer that full-year 2024 rates could be approximated by averaging quarterly figures, but the source only contains Q3 2024 (3.1%) and an incomplete Q4 2024 figure (the number itself is truncated in the text), so no annual rate for 2023 or 2024 can be reliably computed from the supplied evidence.
